panels.description: Total charged amount for billable usage events in the selected time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(charged_cents) / 100 AS "Charged Amount"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'

panels.title: Charged Amount (Selected Period)

panels.description: Current billing cycle on-demand spend from /teams/spend

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(spend_cents), 0) / 100 AS "On-Demand Spend"
FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'

panels.title: On-Demand Spend (Current Cycle)

panels.description: Current billing cycle included (non-on-demand) spend from /teams/spend

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(included_spend_cents), 0) / 100 AS "Included Spend"
FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'

panels.title: Included Spend (Current Cycle)

panels.description: Difference between total cycle spend (on-demand + included) from /teams/spend and sum of chargedCents for events since billing_cycle_start. Positive means spend exceeds collected events (backfill may be incomplete).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(spend_cents + included_spend_cents) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend
    WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'), 0)
  - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(charged_cents) FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
    WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
      AND event_time >= (SELECT MIN(billing_cycle_start) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend
        WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}')), 0)
) / 100 AS "Reconciliation Delta"

panels.title: Reconciliation Delta

panels.description: Total usage events in selected period from filtered-usage-events API

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Usage Events"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'

panels.title: Usage Events (Selected Period)

panels.description: Active roster count from /teams/members where is_removed = 0

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Team Members"
FROM _tool_cursor_members
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND is_removed = 0

panels.title: Team Members

panels.description: Team members with zero active days in the trailing 7-day window (relative to latest collected usage_date)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Inactive Users"
FROM (
  SELECT user_id
  FROM _tool_cursor_daily_usage
  WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
    AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
    AND usage_date >= DATE_SUB(
      (SELECT MAX(usage_date) FROM _tool_cursor_daily_usage
       WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'),
      INTERVAL 6 DAY
    )
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MAX(is_active) = 0
) t

panels.title: Inactive Users (Last 7 Days)

panels.description: Days since most recent usage event; green < 2d, yellow 2-6d, red >= 7d

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, MAX(event_time), UTC_TIMESTAMP()), 9999) AS "Days Since Latest Event"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'

panels.title: Data Freshness

panels.description: Daily charged spend split by billing kind: on-demand (Usage-based) vs included (Included in Business)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE(event_time) AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'Usage-based' THEN charged_cents ELSE 0 END) / 100 AS "On-Demand",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'Included in Business' THEN charged_cents ELSE 0 END) / 100 AS "Included"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY DATE(event_time)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily Spend (On-Demand + Included)

panels.description: Average cost per event, total charged, event count, and share of total events by model for the selected period. Table defaults to charged spend descending.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model AS "Model",
  SUM(total_cents) / COUNT(*) / 100 AS "Avg Cost",
  SUM(charged_cents) / 100 AS "Charged",
  COUNT(*) AS "Events",
  COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS "Usage %"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY SUM(charged_cents) DESC

panels.title: Cost by Model

panels.description: Total charged spend by billing kind for the selected period

targets.rawSql:
SELECT kind AS "Kind",
  SUM(charged_cents) / 100 AS "Charged"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY SUM(charged_cents) DESC

panels.title: Cost by Kind

panels.description: Daily active users based on isActive flag from /teams/daily-usage-data

targets.rawSql:
SELECT usage_date AS time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS "Active Users"
FROM _tool_cursor_daily_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_date)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND is_active = 1
GROUP BY usage_date
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily Active Users (DAU)

panels.description: Tab inline-completion acceptance rate only (tabs_accepted / tabs_shown); see AI Line Acceptance Rate for all accepted lines

targets.rawSql:
SELECT usage_date AS time,
  SUM(tabs_accepted) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(tabs_shown), 0) AS "Acceptance Rate"
FROM _tool_cursor_daily_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_date)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND is_active = 1
GROUP BY usage_date
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tab Acceptance Rate

panels.description: Daily usage-event volume by channel from POST /teams/filtered-usage-events. Admin API does not populate hostingType in collected data (Apr–Jul 2026: 0/105k raw events). Mapping: is_headless=1 → Cloud Agent (~1%); empty hosting_type + not headless → IDE; hosting_type=cli → CLI when present. CLI and authoritative IDE/CLI/Cloud commit activity on the Cursor native dashboard use Enterprise GET /analytics/ai-code/commits (commitSource) — not collected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE(event_time) AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN is_headless = 1 THEN 'Cloud Agent'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(hosting_type, ''))) IN ('cli', 'cursor-cli') THEN 'CLI'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(hosting_type, ''))) IN ('cloud', 'cloud_agent', 'cloud-agent') THEN 'Cloud Agent'
    WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(hosting_type, '')) = '' THEN 'IDE'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Activity by Channel

panels.description: Daily sum of AI-suggested lines accepted into the editor (acceptedLinesAdded from /teams/daily-usage-data)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT usage_date AS time,
  SUM(accepted_lines_added) AS "Accepted Lines Added"
FROM _tool_cursor_daily_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_date)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND is_active = 1
GROUP BY usage_date
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Accepted Lines Added

panels.description: Share of all lines added that came from accepted AI suggestions (accepted_lines_added / total_lines_added). Editor activity only — not committed-code AI share.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT usage_date AS time,
  SUM(accepted_lines_added) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_lines_added), 0) AS "AI Line Acceptance Rate"
FROM _tool_cursor_daily_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_date)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND is_active = 1
GROUP BY usage_date
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: AI Line Acceptance Rate

panels.description: Share of committed lines attributed to TAB, Composer, and non-AI coding from GET /analytics/ai-code/commits (Enterprise API). Requires an enterprise key.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE(ts) AS time,
  metric,
  SUM(value) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(commit_ts, created_at) AS ts,
    'TAB' AS metric,
    tab_lines_added AS value
  FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits
  WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, created_at))
    AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
    AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(commit_ts, created_at),
    'Composer',
    composer_lines_added
  FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits
  WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, created_at))
    AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
    AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(commit_ts, created_at),
    'Non-AI',
    COALESCE(non_ai_lines_added, GREATEST(total_lines_added - tab_lines_added - composer_lines_added, 0))
  FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits
  WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, created_at))
    AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
    AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
) src
GROUP BY DATE(ts), metric
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Committed Lines by AI Source

panels.description: Distribution of commits by source channel (IDE, CLI, Cloud) from GET /analytics/ai-code/commits

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(commit_source, ''), 'unknown'))
    WHEN 'ide' THEN 'IDE'
    WHEN 'cli' THEN 'CLI'
    WHEN 'cloud' THEN 'Cloud'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS "Source",
  COUNT(*) AS "Commits"
FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits
WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, created_at))
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Commits by Source

panels.description: Users ranked by TAB + Composer lines committed in the selected period

targets.rawSql:
SELECT user_email AS "User",
  SUM(tab_lines_added + composer_lines_added) AS "AI Lines Added",
  SUM(total_lines_added) AS "Total Lines Added",
  ROUND(SUM(tab_lines_added + composer_lines_added) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_lines_added), 0), 1) AS "AI Share %"
FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits
WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, created_at))
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY user_email
HAVING SUM(total_lines_added) > 0
ORDER BY SUM(tab_lines_added + composer_lines_added) DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top Contributors by AI-Assisted Lines

panels.description: Overall share of committed lines from TAB, Composer, and manual coding in the selected period

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'TAB' AS "Source",
  ROUND(SUM(tab_lines_added) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_lines_added), 0), 1) AS "Share %"
FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits
WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, created_at))
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Composer',
  ROUND(SUM(composer_lines_added) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_lines_added), 0), 1)
FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits
WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, created_at))
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Non-AI',
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(non_ai_lines_added, GREATEST(total_lines_added - tab_lines_added - composer_lines_added, 0))) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_lines_added), 0), 1)
FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits
WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, created_at))
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'

panels.title: AI Line Coverage (Period)

panels.description: Agent diff acceptance rate (accepted_diffs / suggested_diffs) from GET /analytics/team/agent-edits. Requires enterprise key and Phase 2 collection.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS time,
  SUM(accepted_diffs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(suggested_diffs), 0) AS "Diff Acceptance Rate"
FROM _tool_cursor_agent_edits
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Agent Edit Acceptance Rate

panels.description: Green/red line counts in agent suggestions vs accepted diffs from GET /analytics/team/agent-edits

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS time,
  SUM(green_lines_suggested) AS "Green Lines Suggested",
  SUM(red_lines_suggested) AS "Red Lines Suggested",
  SUM(green_lines_accepted) AS "Green Lines Accepted",
  SUM(red_lines_accepted) AS "Red Lines Accepted"
FROM _tool_cursor_agent_edits
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Agent Edit Line Impact

panels.description: Tab suggestion acceptance rate and line impact from GET /analytics/team/tabs. Richer than daily-usage tabsAccepted/tabsShown counts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS time,
  SUM(suggestions_accepted) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(suggestions_shown), 0) AS "Tab Acceptance Rate",
  SUM(lines_added) AS "Lines Added",
  SUM(lines_deleted) AS "Lines Deleted"
FROM _tool_cursor_tab_analytics
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tab Analytics Acceptance & Line Impact

panels.description: Cross-validation: daily-usage tabs_accepted (Admin API) vs analytics suggestions_accepted (Enterprise Analytics API). Counts may differ due to aggregation timing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.usage_date AS time,
  SUM(d.tabs_accepted) AS "Daily Usage: Tabs Accepted",
  COALESCE(MAX(a.suggestions_accepted), 0) AS "Analytics: Suggestions Accepted"
FROM _tool_cursor_daily_usage d
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT date, SUM(suggestions_accepted) AS suggestions_accepted
  FROM _tool_cursor_tab_analytics
  WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
    AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  GROUP BY date
) a ON DATE(d.usage_date) = DATE(a.date)
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.usage_date)
  AND d.connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND d.scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY d.usage_date
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tab Counts: Daily Usage vs Analytics API

panels.description: Row counts and latest timestamps per _tool_cursor_* table for pipeline health monitoring

targets.rawSql:
SELECT '_tool_cursor_usage_events' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count, MAX(event_time) AS latest
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
UNION ALL
SELECT '_tool_cursor_user_spend', COUNT(*), MAX(collected_at)
FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
UNION ALL
SELECT '_tool_cursor_members', COUNT(*), NULL
FROM _tool_cursor_members
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
UNION ALL
SELECT '_tool_cursor_daily_usage', COUNT(*), MAX(usage_date)
FROM _tool_cursor_daily_usage
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
UNION ALL
SELECT '_tool_cursor_ai_code_commits', COUNT(*), MAX(COALESCE(commit_ts, created_at))
FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
UNION ALL
SELECT '_tool_cursor_ai_code_changes', COUNT(*), MAX(created_at)
FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_changes
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
UNION ALL
SELECT '_tool_cursor_agent_edits', COUNT(*), MAX(date)
FROM _tool_cursor_agent_edits
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
UNION ALL
SELECT '_tool_cursor_tab_analytics', COUNT(*), MAX(date)
FROM _tool_cursor_tab_analytics
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
